title: The Creator seed flow drafts in the launch machine's v2 shape: the coastal first map, niches with pain-point angles, short DMs, three touches for life and creator-seed links
description: On 2026-11-11 the Owner asked for the launch machine (v2 plan, sections 2, 3 and 5). The Creator seed flow (neighborhood-activation) still drafts in the old shape: every note is a signed letter with a P.S., the touch cap resets every 30 days, links carry persona and name the region as the campaign, a draft names no niche or angle, and a hunt cycle may read any page. Now config.json carries first_map (encinitas, carlsbad, solana-del-mar first, inside the North County region, which stays), niches (sound, breathwork, yoga, ecstatic-dance, music, makers-art, venue), each with 2 or 3 pain-point angles (filling the room each week, ticket and platform fees, a crowd scattered across Instagram, WhatsApp and email, no page or list of their own, and for venues teachers each promoting alone), leads.max_touches_per_lead 3 for life (the 30-day cap stays), leads.max_new_contacts_per_day 15, hunts.send_via founder_email, hunts.every_days 1 and one DM door (dm_door /start/host; venues use it with niche venue). seedDraft(cfg, lead, {route, angle, tag, opener}) builds a draft carrying niche, angle and route: a dm has no sign-off and no P.S. and aims for 70 words (40 for a follow-up) with a hard cap of 120; an email keeps the Owner's sign-off, P.S. and reply-no opt-out. Its link goes to /start/host with utm_source=flowweb, utm_medium=one-to-one for a dm, utm_campaign=creator-seed and utm_content=<niche>.<tag>, keeps area and channel and drops persona. routeLeads caps a lead touched three times in its life. The hunt brief lists the allowed sources and never fetches instagram.com or facebook.com; fetchAllowed refuses those hosts and a hunt link to them answers 400. A social hunt draft is unsigned, has no P.S. and its link drops persona. Drafts only: nothing is sent.
acceptance: config.json has first_map starting encinitas, carlsbad, solana-del-mar, the seven niches with 2 or 3 angles each, a lifetime cap of 3 touches, 15 new contacts a day, the founder send route, daily hunts and the /start/host DM door
A dm draft has no sign-off or P.S., is under 120 words and carries niche, angle and route; an email draft keeps the sign-off, P.S. and opt-out
Draft links carry utm_campaign=creator-seed, utm_content=<niche>.<tag>, utm_medium=one-to-one for a dm, area and channel, and no persona; a venue carries niche=venue on /start/host
A fourth touch is refused however long ago the first three were
instagram.com and facebook.com are refused by the hunt fetch guard, and a hunt link to them answers 400
